newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-BULLS FINED FOR NOT MAKING PLAYERS AVAILABLE TO MEDIA.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-BULLS FINED FOR NOT MAKING PLAYERS AVAILABLE TO MEDIA.

text.p: The Chicago Bulls were fined $50,000 by the NBA on Thursday for once again not making their players available to the media following a practice.
The Bulls picked up their second fine of the postseason after players were no-shows following Wednesday's practice.
According to league rules, all teams are required to make their coaches and players available to the media for a 30-minute period before and after all off-day workouts during the playoffs.

The Bulls, who posted an 84-77 victory over Miami on Tuesday in Game 1 of the Eastern Conference finals on Tuesday, were fined $25,000 for the same offence after Game 1 of their series against Atlanta.
